itens.titulo: Not Microsoft. Not Alphabet. Here's the Cloud Giant I'm Most Bullish About.
itens.descricao: Not Microsoft. Not Alphabet. Here's the Cloud Giant I'm Most Bullish About. Yahoo Finance
trechos: There are several companies spending more than $100 billion each to build and equip new data centers this year, and their capital expenditures are projected to rise once again in 2027.
Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.
But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase.
"Act 2" is the global rollout.
Continue » AWS is seeing its growth accelerate AWS is the biggest cloud computing service in the world, with a market share of about 28%.
In its pursuit of that market, it has been spending more and more on cloud infrastructure, and it's on course for around $220 billion in data center capital expenditures this year.
During the second quarter, AWS revenue grew 37% year over year.
For comparison, it grew 28% during the first quarter and 24% in 2025's fourth quarter.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa amplia perdas com inflação nos EUA e eleição no radar; dólar sobe
itens.descricao: Ibovespa amplia perdas com inflação nos EUA e eleição no radar; dólar sobe Exame
trechos: Por volta das 11h (horário de Brasília), o índice recuava 1,32%, aos 204.166 pontos.
O dólar comercial sobe 0,50%, cotado a R$ 5,046.
Na B3, Vale (VALE3) recua 1,44%, mas Petrobras ajuda a limitar as perdas, com PETR3 subindo 1,96% e PETR4, 1,72%, acompanhando a alta do petróleo.
Prio (PRIO3) ganha 1,08% Itaú (ITUB4) cai 1,51%, Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) perde 2,10% e BTG Pactual (BPAC11, do mesmo grupo controlador da EXAME) cede 3,38%.
B3 (B3SA3) também cai 3,47%, enquanto Cyrela (CYRE3), Cury (CURY3) e Tenda (TEND3) recuam mais de 3%.
Nos Estados Unidos, o Índice de Preços ao Consumidor (CPI, na sigla em inglês) subiu 0,6% em setembro e 3,7% em 12 meses.
O núcleo, que exclui alimentos e energia, avançou 0,3% no mês, acima dos 0,2% esperados.

"O movimento reflete a realização de lucros após o rali e a reavaliação dos riscos associados ao cenário político e fiscal." A disputa presidencial segue entre os principais fatores acompanhados pelos investidores.

itens.titulo: Is AMD Even a Real Threat to Nvidia or Just a Pricing Lever?
itens.descricao: Is AMD Even a Real Threat to Nvidia or Just a Pricing Lever? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - AMD's Helios racks claim 30% better token economics, but NVIDIA's Data Center revenue hit $89B at a 75% gross margin, which is nearly 13x AMD's figure.
- AMD trades at 228x earnings versus NVIDIA's 46x, making Helios shipment volumes the decisive variable for investors betting on the gap closing.
Helios Is AMD's Opening Shot While Vera Rubin Already Ships AMD's revenue rose 50.1% to $11.54B.
Data Center sales reached $6.72B, or 58% of revenue, so AMD now runs mostly as a server company.
Lisa Su said "Customer pull for Helios is very strong and tracking ahead of our initial forecasts." NVIDIA's Data Center unit produced $89.02B, up 117%.
Networking alone brought in $40.31B, more than AMD's entire quarterly revenue.
